$comment: A minimal capability map: one row per user story, 1-5 scenarios each, four evidence arrays — one per lane, with data and response sharing tests[] (see recipe.md), and a verdict. Rows are appended in lockstep with the outcome doc that promises them; capability_find.py is the only reader.

rows.story: A member mutes a channel so it stops notifying them, and unmutes it to resume.

scenarios.then: she gets no push or badge from it

rows.story: A mute is per member: one member muting a channel changes nothing for another.

scenarios.when: Ben (unmuted) gets a message in it

rows.story: A member can see which of their channels are muted.

scenarios.then: #general shows a muted marker beside its name

rows.$comment: The cited test is data-altitude (it calls the query directly); the Then is perception (what Ana sees in the list). Real evidence, wrong altitude, so the verdict stays under-proven until an e2eTests[] citation lands — references/altitude.md, The verdict rule.
